mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <= 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is declining.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in <= 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in <= 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 320), an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in <= 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market, supporting wage growth and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <= 40% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in <= 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in <= 40% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery phase (PAYEMS growth > 100k), strong job growth supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <= 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k.
